signals.title: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
signals.detail: Of 26,827 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,321 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
signals.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
signals.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.
